pages.text: AdminShop is a mod that lets you buy and sell items from a fictional "market" at a fixed price. It supports shared balances through $(l)FTB Teams$(). The shop's items and prices are set by either the server owner or modpack maker.$(br)It is $(l)not$() a "player-to-player" shop mod.
There are two ways to buy and sell items, you can use the $(item)Shop$() to manually buy and sell items, or for automated setups, the $(item)Buyer$() and $(item)Seller$().
